name: 古根撼地獸
prompt: Production animation sheet for EXACT character in reference. EIGHT equally spaced columns and 4 rows, 32 full-body drawings. Wide landscape sheet, maximum resolution. Column directions FIXED in every row: 1 FRONT; 2 FRONT RIGHT; 3 RIGHT PROFILE; 4 BACK RIGHT; 5 BACK; 6 BACK LEFT; 7 LEFT PROFILE; 8 FRONT LEFT. Columns6,7,8 noses point SCREEN LEFT. Back shows back, no face. Same creature identity, anatomy, colors and equipment in ALL views, never mirror handedness. Four subtle breathing idle keyframes; natural sway, SAME scale. Ancient quadruped root giant, body braided intertwining thick roots, four strong articulated claw-root legs, stumpy tree crown head, branch antlers, moss and tiny trees on back, yellow-green sap fissures. Detailed Japanese manga dark fantasy JRPG monster illustration, fine variable-weight ink lines, cel-shaded shadows plus subtle gradients and highlights, consistent upper-left light. Slightly stylized semi-chibi proportions: humanoids about 4.5 to 5 heads tall, mature faces, slightly larger head and hands, compact limbs; creatures have heads about 12% larger than natural with compact expressive silhouette. NOT tiny 2.5-head chibi, not baby-like, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Identical camera scale across every frame including collapsed ones. All feet/tails/weapons fit INSIDE each cell with at least 12% empty gutters on ALL sides. No grid or labels. NO overlapping neighbors; no clipping. Return a clean RGBA sprite sheet.
